4210-4279-5687--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4210-4279-5687--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple, Skittering Precursor and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4050-7084-8232.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters and Alharu trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Alharu trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2137-4642-5434.description:
Cast Awaken the Woods with X equal to 3 by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control to their owner's hand, copying Awaken the Woods.
Resolve the copy of Awaken the Woods, creating three 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
Activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
2137-4642-5434.notes: Once you have infinite green mana and infinite land tokens, you may activate Uyo any number of times, targeting any number of instant or sorcery spells.

413-4871-8168.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token with flying due to Draconic Visitor.
When the Dragon enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable with Two or Less Mana

728-2757-3249--207.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Grimgrin, untapping a basic land.
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the cheap creature, untapping a basic land.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the cheap creature, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
728-2757-3249--207.notes: This combo only produces infinite mana if the creature costs one mana or less.

645-1267-5361-8095.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-5361-8095.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Auton Soldier.
Auton Soldier triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Auton Soldier
Repeat each turn.

480-3899-6981-7077.description:
Cast Illicit Masquerade by paying {3}{B}. When it enters, its first ability triggers, putting an impostor counter on Skullbriar.
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Skullbriar.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Skullbriar.
When Skullbriar dies, Illicit Masquerade's second ability and Skullbriar's ability granted to it by Perigee Beckoner trigger.
Resolve the Skullbriar trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Illicit Masquerade trigger, failing to exile Skullbriar as it has left your graveyard and returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 3.

7084-7422-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-7192-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

360-1981-2415-2438.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
360-1981-2415-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1477-3197-7810.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing an artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
Repeat.

997-1394-2060-7038-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
997-1394-2060-7038-7803.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Brad Boimler.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Brad Boimler.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

215-3291-4742.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 6.
215-3291-4742.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Karametra's Acolyte from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Karametra's Acolyte by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

215-3443-4460.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
215-3443-4460.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding an amount of {B} or {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deathbloom Ritualist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Deathbloom Ritualist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-3443-4460.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {B}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Deathbloom Ritualist

38-2713-4640--168.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing the Goblin Samurai, adding {R}.
When the Goblin Samurai dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning the Goblin Samurai from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Oathkeeper's equip ability by paying {1} due to Zirda, attaching it to the Goblin Samurai.
Repeat.

4659-7766-7767.description:
Cast Ultron either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{U}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Ultron enters, Prowler triggers, causing it to connive.
Ultron triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 2/2 Robot Villain creature token.
When the Robot Villain enters, Prowler triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Robot Villain, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Prowler ability, causing it to connive.
Repeat from step 3.

3808-4050-5394.description:
Activate Halsin by paying {1}, causing an artifact token you control to become a 4/4 Bear in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Bear, adding {1}.
When the Bear dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token.
Repeat.

240-2921-5929.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Leyline of Transformation, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-2921-5929.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

573-1558-2638-4231-4321.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
573-1558-2638-4231-4321.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Peregrin Took.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1133-1825-3476.easyPrerequisites:
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {U}{U}.
It is your upkeep step.
1133-1825-3476.description:
During your upkeep, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Hakim's first ability by paying {U}{U}, returning Treachery from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Hakim.
When Treachery enters, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Phantatog by sacrificing Treachery.
Repeat.

240-2034-4927-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {C}{C}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

821-2173-5220-7286.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

4785-5475-7163.easyPrerequisites: You are able to put a triggered ability on the stack.
4785-5475-7163.description:
Put any triggered ability on the stack.
Holding priority, activate Dynaheir by tapping it.
Activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, targeting the ability from step 1.
Dynaheir triggers. Holding priority, activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Mister Fantastic.
Activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, copying Dynaheir's trigger twice
Resolve the first copy of Dynaheir's trigger, copying Mister Fantastic's ability, targeting Dynaheir's trigger
Resolve the copy of Mister Fantastic's ability, copying Dynaheir's trigger twice.
Repeat from step 6

56-1417-5256-6887.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-1417-5256-6887.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Bridge from Below and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-1417-5256-6887.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

944-1621-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

586-5173-5626.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
586-5173-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Shambling Ghast and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Priest of Gix and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

2060-2713-5660-5681.description:
Activate Jukai Preserver by paying {G} and discarding it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler and Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Jukai Preserver from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

919-2051-2546-4298.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
919-2051-2546-4298.description:
Activate Lonely Sandbar's cycling ability by paying {U} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Lonely Sandbar ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.

Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Borborygmos Enraged ability, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate the three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Lonely Sandbar and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1308-3996-4050.description:
Activate Twilight Drover by paying {2}{W} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating four 1/1 Spirit creature tokens with flying.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Spirits, adding {2}{W}.
When the Spirits die, Twilight Drover triggers three times, putting three +1/+1 counters on itself.
Repeat.

3532-3594-4985-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Toothy triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ratchet, Field Medic // Ratchet, Rescue Racer

1874-4605-5118-5144.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 2 life this turn.
1874-4605-5118-5144.description:
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Ratchet, causing it to enter the battlefield as Ratchet, Field Medic.
When Ratchet, Field Medic enters the battlefield, Preston and Ajani's Welcome trigger.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Ratchet, Field Medic that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Put the nontoken Ratchet into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Choose not to return Ratchet to the command zone from your graveyard.
When the Ratchet, Field Medic token enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
The Ratchet, Field Medic token triggers, causing you to convert it into Ratchet, Rescue Racer, and return Ratchet from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Ratchet, Field Medic enters the battlefield, Preston and Ajani's Welcome trigger.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Ratchet, Field Medic that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Put the nontoken Ratchet into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Choose not to return Ratchet to the command zone from your graveyard.
The Ratchet, Rescue Racer token triggers, as well as Ajani's Welcome.
Resolve the Ratchet, Rescue Racer trigger, causing you to convert it into Ratchet, Field Medic.
Put one of the Ratchet, Field Medic tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Resolve the Ajani's Welcome trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 7.

323-1580-3479-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}.
Falkenrath Noble and Life Insurance triggers.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing target player to lose 1 life and gaining you 1 life.
Resolve the Life Insurance trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing itself, adding {B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

283-4644.notablePrerequisites:
Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Tidewater Minion.
283-4644.description:

Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping Tidewater Minion and the other target.
Activate that permanent by tapping it for mana or other results if possible.
Repeat.

876-1778-4763-5147.description:
Equip Memnite with Lightning Greaves.
Sacrifice Memnite to Goblin Bombardment to deal 1 damage to any target.
Koll triggers, returning Memnite to you hand.
Cast Memnite.
Repeat.

2773-4050-5003-5296.description:
Activate Workhorse by removing four +1/+1 counters, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Workhorse, adding one mana of any color.
Workhorse dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Workhorse from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Workhorse enters the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it.
Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing 4 damages to any target.
